decisions.statement: Where a line is filed is worked out here rather than beside a module.
A line filed at a whole path is written under the root that path is read against.
A line is written closed by a line end.
A line is read back only to reach the path a slug is already filed under.
A value filed for a page is written as that page's body at that page's path.
A value carrying no id is filed under an id worked out from that page's path.
A body already at that path is left as the caller wrote it.
A body is bound to the name the slug that value states makes.
A value stating no slug is bound to `held`.
A body written here is named as every check over a tree wants a page named.
A value filed for a page files that page under its slug and its id as well.
A slug the value does not state is read off the page's own file name.
A roster line already at that path is left as the caller wrote it.
A shape filed is written beside its page type.
Where that page type sits is read off the line already filed under its slug.
A shape whose page type is filed nowhere is not written.

definition: the index lines and page bodies a test files into a root of its own
